Four travellers must cross a bridge at night with one torch. At most two cross at a time and a pair moves at the slower person's pace. They take 1, 2, 5 and 10 minutes. What is the fastest total crossing time, and what is the schedule?

This is the classic bridge-crossing puzzle with crossers 1, 2, 5, 10. The optimal strategy: send 1&2 across, send 1 back, send 5&10 across, send 2 back, then 1&2 cross again, totaling 2+1+10+2+2 = 17 minutes. I should double-check this is i…[5625 chars]
